repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-dss
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.dss for the Directory Search Service (DSS). register() connects the shared mercury socket and listens for directory lookup and search events; lookupDetail, lookup, lookupByEmail, lookupByPhoneNumbers, search, and searchPlaces POST a query with a generated requestId to the directorySearch service, then collect the sequenced result pages that arrive over mercury until the finished page, rejecting with DssTimeoutError when no page arrives within requestTimeout. lookup is batched per resource through a webex-core Batcher by default. It stores nothing.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-dss package entry
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package registers DSS as internal plugin 'dss' with config {dss: {requestTimeout: 6000, batcherWait: 50, batcherMaxCalls: 50, batcherMaxWait: 150}}; the first registration of the name wins. The default export is the only export; constants, types, and DssTimeoutError are reachable only by deep src paths.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.dss methods and events
public_interfaces.notes: Results arrive over mercury only after register(). lookupDetail, lookup, and lookupByEmail resolve one entity or null; lookupByPhoneNumbers and searchPlaces resolve {resultArray, ...}; search resolves an array. Silence for requestTimeout rejects with DssTimeoutError. Events: dss:registered, dss:unregistered, dss:lookup.result.

public_interfaces.notes: build runs build:src, which writes dist. test chains test:integration, which is not defined; test:browser runs test/integration/spec/dss.js through karma but currently bundles nothing and reports 0 tests, so use test:unit and test:style.

evidence_rules.requirement: Ground every behavioral claim in source or test evidence.
evidence_rules.notes: Commit history is not an evidence source for this package. README.md is context only and partly stale (docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md). The internal-plugin-mercury specification is stale on the session model and the internal-plugin-device specification is silent on orgId; use those packages' code.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not call lookup or lookupByEmail with arrays (ids or emails).
negative_guidance.why: Both take one value (src/types.ts); only the README shows arrays. Several ids coalesce through the batcher instead.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not expect results without register().
negative_guidance.why: Results arrive over mercury, which register() connects and subscribes to; the HTTP response is never read.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not read the webex.request response for results.
negative_guidance.why: The service delivers results as sequenced mercury pages matched by requestId.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log looked-up ids, emails, phone numbers, query strings, or entities.
negative_guidance.why: They are organization directory data; existing log lines carry only error messages and counts.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the signature or unregister reference.
negative_guidance.why: Several of its claims differ from code; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: The legacy Jest config sets no threshold and no coverage script exists.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, and the behavior has a case in test/unit/spec.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example registration through the entry, connect failure, webex.request failure, a batch timeout, or the searchPlaces result. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question. Stop and report the gap.
